name: The Ember Room
tagline: Wood-fired American cuisine in the heart of the city
description: The Ember Room is a cozy upscale American bistro specializing in wood-fired dishes, craft cocktails, and locally sourced seasonal ingredients. Founded in 2018, we pride ourselves on warm hospitality and unforgettable dining experiences.

reservation_policy.cancellation_policy: We kindly ask for at least 24 hours notice for cancellations. Late cancellations or no-shows for parties of 5 or more may be subject to a $25 per person fee.
reservation_policy.notes: We hold reservations for 15 minutes past the booking time. Please call us if you are running late.

faqs.question: Do you accommodate dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We can accommodate most dietary needs including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free. Please inform us when booking or speak with your server. Our kitchen handles nuts, dairy, and shellfish — please alert us to severe allergies.

faqs.question: Is there parking nearby?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is a public parking garage on Ashwood Lane one block north, and street parking is available on weeknights. Valet is available Friday and Saturday evenings starting at 6 PM for $12.

faqs.question: Do you have a dress code?
faqs.answer: Smart casual. We ask that guests avoid athletic wear or beachwear. We want everyone to feel comfortable and enjoy the atmosphere.

faqs.question: Can you accommodate large parties or events?
faqs.answer: Yes! We can host private events for up to 50 guests in our private dining room. Please call us or email reservations@theemberroom.com for event inquiries.

faqs.question: Do you have a kids menu?
faqs.answer: We don't have a dedicated kids menu, but our kitchen is happy to prepare simple dishes for little ones. Please ask your server.
